talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 176 solo PCPs winding down in Texas; 32 ZIP(s) have 2+ at once (Mission 78572, Laredo 78041, Houston 77008) — each a ~12-month drive-time compliance gap.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~19,569 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.
**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (Bastrop County, Parker County, Johnson County) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 41 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~616,800 patients across 514 at-risk practices statewide.
